sources.when: an authoritative completed Clash is saved to the career (any supported mode)
the saved Clash's outcome is a win; a tie or a loss earns none
the account's first completed Clash in that Era (once per account per Era, decided by the unique constraint)
the account's official challenge attempt is completed
another ACCOUNT completes an official attempt against the creator's challenge (guests earn the creator nothing)
an achievement's target is met by the account's records; once per achievement id

idempotency: unique (user_id, source_type, source_id, reason) on xp_ledger; every trigger runs the same reconcile; refresh, retry, re-save, concurrency and backfill insert nothing twice
authority: server-derived from saved_clashes, challenge_attempts and challenges; no request body field is read
